players.product: intismeran autogene (V940/mRNA-4157) individualized neoantigen therapy, jointly developed with Merck

quarterly_data.signal: 10-Q: Q2 2026 net product sales by customer location were United States $70 million, Europe $16 million and rest of world $8 million (first half: $143 million, $255 million and $48 million). Cost of sales of $93 million included inventory write-downs of $41 million, unutilized manufacturing capacity costs of $23 million and third-party royalties of $11 million; first-half third-party royalties included $884 million related to the litigation settlement with Arbutus and Genevant and amortization of the associated intangible asset. Deferred revenue related to customer advance payments was $442 million at June 30, 2026.

quarterly_data.signal: 10-Q litigation: in July 2026 Translate Bio, Inc., Translate Bio MA, Inc., Sanofi Vaccines US, Inc. and VaxServe, Inc. (all subsidiaries of Sanofi SA) filed a complaint in the U.S. District Court for the District of New Jersey asserting that Moderna's manufacture and sale of its COVID and RSV vaccines infringe U.S. patents related to compositions and methods for mRNA delivery; the complaint seeks unspecified damages.
